meta.name: skills-guide
meta.description: This skill should be loaded when creating a skill, modifying a SKILL.md, writing skill frontmatter, reviewing skill quality, or authoring skill descriptions. Defines conventions for SKILL.md files - frontmatter, content structure, and review criteria.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按规范编写和审查技能说明文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在编写或完善技能文档
copy.tagline_en: Write and review skill specs following clear guidelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're authoring or improving agent skill files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 编写或修改 SKILL.md 文件时,会遵循 frontmatter 字段写法、正文步骤式结构、篇幅限制等规范,避免模糊描述,并考虑 Claude Code 和 Codex 等平台的兼容性。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 创建技能、修改 SKILL.md 或审查技能质量等技能编写相关操作时,它会自动加载这套规范。

say.text: 帮我新建一个技能,按规范写好 SKILL.md。
say.note: Claude 会按 frontmatter 和内容规则生成。

say.text: 检查这个技能的 SKILL.md 有什么不合规的地方。
say.note: 它会按审查标准逐条核对。

say.text: 把技能的 description 改成带具体触发词的写法。

howto.what_en: When writing or editing SKILL.md, Claude follows conventions for frontmatter fields, step-by-step content structure, length limits, avoiding vague descriptions, and portability across Claude Code and Codex.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create a skill, modify a SKILL.md, or review skill quality, among similar skill-authoring tasks.

say_en.text: Create a new skill and write its SKILL.md per the conventions.
say_en.note: Claude follows the frontmatter and content rules.

say_en.text: Check this skill's SKILL.md for spec violations.
Rewrite this skill's description with concrete trigger phrases.
